name: Adult Red Dragon
senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 23

abilities.name: Scar-Sight
abilities.description: The red dragon can pinpoint the location of worked steel and open wounds within 120 feet of itself.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If the red dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Sight Weakness
abilities.description: The red dragon has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The red dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast *Scorching Ray*.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The red dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks): - **At will:** *Command*, *Detect Magic*, *Scorching Ray*
**1/day each:** *Fireball*

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 59 (17d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Commanding Presence
legendary_actions.description: The red dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *Command* (level 2 version). The red dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Fiery Rays
legendary_actions.description: The red dragon uses Spellcasting to cast *Scorching Ray*. The red dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description: The red dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
